name: Ice Wall
primary:
Quick cover that melts away on its own.
A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: ice, melts after 30 s.
self_description: A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: ice, melts after 30 s. No extra effects.
